name: Bernice
bio: Bernice, sister of King Agrippa (Herod Agrippa II), came with him to Caesarea to greet Festus and was present, with great pomp, when Agrippa heard Festus explain Paul's case and asked to hear Paul himself (Acts 25:13, 23). She was present when Paul made his defense before Agrippa and Festus, and afterward joined them in agreeing that Paul had done nothing deserving death (Acts 26:30-32).
